statement: For each of the 21 N342 residual terminals, maximize the Picard self-square over the larger real affine space fixing degree, all 48 exceptional pairings to 1, and x4. If that exact real maximum is already below the required self-square lower bound, the terminal is pruned a fortiori before integrality/nonnegativity/effectivity.

scope.quantifiers: per terminal exact real quadratic maximum
scope.required_output: exact negative-definiteness certificate and exact rational upper bound ledger

next_action: Run the exact N343 verifier. If all 21 real affine maxima are below the required lower bounds, retain the ledger and prepare an external hostile-audit handoff before any N350 producer registration or FULL178 promotion.
notes: Normal nonnegativity and Picard integrality are deliberately omitted in N343, so the computed maximum is a safe upper bound for the smaller admissible set.
